room.name: The Courtyard
room.description: The open courtyard of Ar-Rayaan — dua requests, questions, and announcements. Be kind; everyone here is carrying something.

threads.title: Welcome to the Courtyard — read first, in shaa Allah

posts.body: As-salamu alaikum wa rahmatullah, and welcome. This courtyard is the open square of the app: ask questions, request dua, share announcements. Three courtesies: speak as if the Prophet ﷺ is listening; assume good intent; and when you disagree, disagree with ideas, never with people. The Adab Engine holds the gate — let us hold the tone.

threads.title: Dua request: my father starts chemo next week

posts.body: Please keep my father in your duas — first round of chemo begins Monday. His name is Mahmoud. May Allah grant him shifa and reward every one of you for a single sincere 'Rabbana atina'.
Allahumma ashfi Mahmoud, shifa'an 'ajilan ghayra 'ajilin. Ameen. The Daily Duas shelf in Stories holds the dua of illness — recite it for him tonight.

threads.title: Question: praying while travelling — when does qasr begin and end?

posts.body: I travel weekly for work. I know travel shortens the prayer, but when exactly does the 'travel' state start and end? Jazakum Allahu khairan.

A great case for the Huda shelf (Travel — The Wayfarer's Adab). In brief, the majority count travel from when you leave your city's boundary until you intend to stay 15+ days; the shortened prayer is then combined. Views differ among the schools and all are valid — consult a local teacher for your case.
